repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-lyra
repository.purpose: Internal plugin registered as webex.internal.lyra for Lyra spaces (room devices). getAdvertisedEndpoint() resolves an ultrasound token to the advertising space through the proximity service. The space child lists and reads the user's spaces, joins (default pass type MANUAL, with the current device url) and leaves them, verifies occupants, reads bindings, and binds and unbinds conversations with KMS create and delete authorization messages for the space identity; join, leave, bindConversation, and unbindConversation take a space.url relative to the lyra service, while the other space methods take an absolute one. The device child reads and reports audio state and invokes mute, unmute, and volume actions under the audio resource of the space url. It stores nothing itself.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/internal-plugin-lyra package entry
public_interfaces.audience: first-party Webex clients and the SDK packages that register it
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package imports the mercury, encryption, conversation, and feature plugins, then registers Lyra as internal plugin 'lyra' with config {lyra: {}}; the first registration of the name wins. The default export Lyra and the named export config are the only exports.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.lyra methods
public_interfaces.notes: The space and device children are defined in src/space.js and src/device.js. join, leave, bindConversation, and unbindConversation take a space.url relative to the lyra service (/spaces/ followed by the space id); verifyOccupant, getCurrentBindings, deleteBinding, and every device method take an absolute space.url. getAdvertisedEndpoint, list, get, getCurrentBindings, bindConversation, getAudioState, and putAudioState resolve the response body (items for list); the others resolve the whole response. Argument guards reject before any request; a missing space throws synchronously.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not pass an absolute space.url to join, leave, bindConversation, or unbindConversation, or a relative one to the other space and device methods.
negative_guidance.why: The first group sends it as a lyra catalog resource and the second as the request uri (INV-001).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not put an unwrapped KMS message in a query string.
negative_guidance.why: The outbound KMS transform only reaches body.kmsMessage (INV-003).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not change which methods resolve the body and which the whole response.
negative_guidance.why: @webex/plugin-device-manager and first-party clients read those values.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log ultrasound tokens, proofs, device URLs, or KMS messages.
negative_guidance.why: They identify users and devices; the package has no log line today.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as a usage reference.
negative_guidance.why: Its Usage block names a placeholder member; see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: No coverage script or threshold exists.
